transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I guess what made me decide to come in is that, for the past few weeks, my eating has just been really off. I’ll end up skipping breakfast and lunch without really meaning to. And then I just kind of pick at dinner, even when my wife cooked. I've noticed my jeans are starting to feel pretty loose, too. So... yeah, I figured I should probably come in and talk to someone about it.
Along with the changes in your eating, how has your mood been over these past few weeks?

It’s been pretty low, honestly. Most days lately, I just wake up with this... heavy, flat feeling. It’s like the apartment is just too quiet, you know? And usually, playing music helps me, but lately, even picking up my guitar doesn’t really lift me out of it.
Have you ever gone through a period like this before, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

I'm not really sure, honestly. I mean, I've had times where I felt a bit down before, but... I don't know if it was exactly like this. It's hard to say for sure if it's the first time it's been this noticeable.
Have you ever had times where you felt the opposite—unusually energized, wired, or needing much less sleep than usual?

Yeah, actually... I have had times like that. There was a stretch where, for several nights, I only slept maybe three or four hours. But I wasn't tired at all. I'd wake up feeling completely charged. It honestly felt like sleep was just getting in the way of finishing the next music track I was working on, or getting a spreadsheet done. I just didn't feel like I needed to sleep.
During that time when you felt so energized and needed very little sleep, about how long did that stretch last?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. Um... I wasn't exactly keeping track of the days while it was happening, so it's hard to remember exactly how long that whole stretch lasted.
Have you noticed this pattern of shifting between highs and lows happening continuously for two years or longer?

I don't think so. I mean, I haven't really noticed it going on for that long continuously. It's more like... things just happen when they happen, but I wouldn't say it's been a constant two-year thing.
